issues.legal_issue: A further intra-court appeal is unavailable from a single judge’s appellate order on an appealable interlocutory injunction order when the governing procedural law bars a further appeal.
material_facts: A company sued to challenge steps taken against it and sought an injunction preserving its possession of a hotel.
The trial court ordered the parties to maintain the existing position, leaving the company in possession.
On the other side’s appeal, a single judge vacated that order while exercising appellate jurisdiction.
The company then filed a Letters Patent Appeal, which the Division Bench held was not maintainable.
issues.conclusion: The Letters Patent Appeal did not lie because the single judge’s order was made in appellate jurisdiction and the statutory bar on a further appeal applied. The appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: A right of appeal is statutory. Under Section 104(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, read with Order XLIII Rule 1(r), an appeal lies from an order concerning an injunction under Order XXXIX Rule 1; Section 104(2) bars an appeal from an order passed in an appeal under Section 104. Section 4(1) does not displace that express bar. Clause 10 of the Letters Patent does not provide a further appeal in this circumstance. Resham Singh Pyara Singh v. Abdul Sattar supports the bar on a Letters Patent Appeal from such an appellate order. Shah Babulal Khimji v. Jayaben D.C. Kania concerned a single judge exercising original jurisdiction and does not establish a right of further appeal here merely because the order may be a judgment within Section 2(9) of the Code. The contrary views in Sukuri Dibya and Birendra Kumar Majhi were held not to be good law.

predicates.intra_court_appeal_from_single_judge: A party filed an intra-court appeal from an order made by a single judge.
predicates.single_judge_exercised_appellate_jurisdi: The single judge made the challenged order while deciding an appeal from a lower court’s order.
predicates.underlying_order_concerned_interlocutory: The order challenged before the single judge concerned interim injunctive relief.
predicates.governing_procedure_bars_further_appeal: The procedural law governing the appeal expressly prohibits a further appeal from an order made in that appeal.

issues.definition: When an intra-court appeal challenges a single judge’s appellate decision on an interlocutory injunction and the governing procedure bars a further appeal, the further appeal is not maintainable.
